name: an AsyncQueue alone
code: import { AsyncQueue } from '@reely/queue'; void new AsyncQueue().add(() => 1);

name: both queues and the app's own emitter
code: import { EventEmitter } from '@reely/emitter'; import { AsyncQueue, SyncQueue } from '@reely/queue'; new SyncQueue().add(() => 1); void new AsyncQueue().add(() => 1); new EventEmitter().emit('saved');
